posts.author: EbonSkolli
posts.body:
I just made a quick plugin that allows battlers to target enemies with 0% Target Rate. This is intended as a passive state with other plugins or something that an item/skill can apply. It's modeled after the "See Invisibility" spell in dnd. Obviously, this is geared toward combat-use, but you can expand this by creating a common event with a conditional branch if you want players to be able to see "invisible" things on the map.
HOW TO USE:
This plugin is super simple. Just make a state called "Arcane Sight" (or whatever you want to call it), then set the parameter in the plugin to the same state ID.
TERMS OF USE:
Use for commercial or non-commercial projects. Please credit EbonSkolli if you use this plugin.

I'm not sure what you're referring to. My plugin doesn't disable being able to target enemies with 0% target rate. That's a default in all RPG Maker softwares, at least every one that I've ever used. 0% target rate is essentially invisibility; anything above that and a target can be targeted.

It's not the case in MZ, which is the engine your plugin is for and the one you primarily use according to your account settings. It's also not the case in MV, nor in Ace. I can't speak on anything prior to that, but that hasn't been true for any of the releases made in at least the past 15 years.
Have you not ran a blank project or looked at the code to see what happens normally before making a plugin to change it?
EbonSkolli said:
My plugin doesn't disable being able to target enemies with 0% target rate
Click to expand...
Line 80 does that, and you reach it by having an enemy at 0% TGR with the current actor not having the sight state. It outright prevents the player from selecting the enemy. Skills with manual enemy selections have no restriction other than the enemy being alive to be placed in the list in the first place.
